niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces with strong, legible structure and clear top-down hierarchy; content that feels complete and task-oriented rather than empty; restrained headers with centered or otherwise balanced titles; cohesive grouped sections using flat rows or unified panels instead of fragmented modules; concise icon-led informational blocks over large decorative hero imagery; and polished contemporary styling with rounded components, subtle personality, and clear visible actions. They also repeatedly favor interfaces that surface enough information and controls to feel functional and explicit, while avoiding promotional onboarding clutter and weakly defined layouts.

criteria.description: Prefers strong top-down organization with prominent titles, clear section labels, grouped content, and obvious focal progression between elements.
Prefers screens that feel populated, explicit, and operational, with visible items, actions, and enough surfaced information to immediately communicate the workflow.
Prefers minimal, balanced header treatments—often centered titles and reduced chrome—rather than dominant banners, oversized left-aligned headlines, or busy branded tops.
Prefers consolidated, orderly section structure such as unified settings cards, full-width rows with dividers, or larger coherent panels instead of fragmented boxes and detached modules.
Prefers concise icon-supported cards or feature blocks and semantic icon anchors over large photo heroes, carousels, or decorative imagery dominating the screen.
Prefers interfaces where primary and item-level actions are directly visible, legible, and intentionally emphasized rather than hidden, ambiguous, or implied.
Prefers refined modern UI details such as soft rounded cards, consistent padding, subtle dividers, and understated but polished component styling over chunkier or more mechanical treatments.
